item.title: The Philippines: DEFA to Build a Resilient and Inclusive Digital ASEAN
item.description: ASEAN negotiators and legal experts met in Manila to advance the Digital Economy Framework Agreement, aiming to strengthen digital trade, support SMEs and boost cross-border integration.

item.title: Singapore: Shaping Future-Ready Talent in Semiconductors
item.description: Singapore is strengthening its semiconductor workforce by promoting AI skills, inclusive workplaces and mentorship initiatives, creating opportunities for women and preparing talent for the evolving landscape.

item.title: India Strengthens Legal Protections for Children in the Age of AI
item.description: India is strengthening legal safeguards, data protection and governance frameworks to ensure responsible AI use, especially protecting children and vulnerable populations in the digital environment.

item.title: Malaysia: Digital System Streamlines Expatriate Recruitment
item.description: Malaysia introduces a digital platform centralising expatriate employment applications, integrating immigration systems to streamline approvals and improve transparency for investors.

item.title: The Philippines: Digital Skills Boost Lamitan Women’s Business Success
item.description: DICT Basilan has empowered Lamitan womenpreneurs with digital skills, enabling them to enhance online marketing, engage customers and grow their businesses through practical technology training.

item.title: Australia: Researchers Test Long-Range Wireless Technology
item.description: Researchers demonstrate low-frequency wireless signals can provide reliable long-range connectivity for rural monitoring systems, supporting agriculture, infrastructure management and remote sensing.

item.title: New Zealand: Digital Innovation from Ports to Screens
item.description: New Zealand is leveraging advanced digital technology to modernise coastal shipping, streamline food labelling and expand media access, enhancing efficiency, connectivity and transparency across multiple sectors.

item.title: Hong Kong PolyU Develops Ultrasound Brain-Computer Interface
item.description: PolyU researchers develop an ultrasound-based brain-computer interface enabling non-invasive deep brain modulation, offering a potential treatment approach for Parkinson’s disease.

item.title: Vietnam and EU Poised to Strengthen AI Collaboration
item.description: Vietnam and the European Union are well positioned to expand AI cooperation by combining Europe’s research expertise with Vietnam’s skilled workforce, infrastructure and supportive policy environment.

item.title: Singapore: Stronger Quantum Talent and Research Infrastructure
item.description: Singapore has launched a new national quantum R&D centre to advance research, foster talent and strengthen its ecosystem for developing practical applications of quantum computing technologies.
